title: GSC ROV, underwater inspection and launch-and-recovery discovery

selectedGap.reason: Search Console exposed recurring demand for Canadian ROV inspection, regional service and launch-and-recovery providers not fully represented in the production corpus.

guardrailNotes: Search and social results were discovery only; every proposed public leaf maps to durable official, government, customer, registry or association evidence.
The run distinguishes ROV operators and integrators from manufacturers and does not infer defence adoption from general marine contracts.
The 21-record universe is retained without filler; supportable subsidiaries keep explicit parent relationships and unresolved records receive typed dispositions.
